repositories.name: ECC
repositories.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repositories.summary: ECC 是一个为 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、规则、记忆与安全配置的性能优化系统，用于增强代理的工程协作能力。

repositories.name: skills
repositories.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repositories.summary: 一套面向真实工程实践的AI代理技能集，包含代码开发与效率工具，可通过插件或脚本快速安装使用。

repositories.name: diagram-design
repositories.description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repositories.summary: 为Claude Code等AI编程工具提供38种编辑级HTML与SVG图表模板，可生成无阴影、非Mermaid风格的静态图表。

repositories.name: hermes-agent
repositories.description: The agent that grows with you
repositories.summary: Hermes Agent 是 Nous Research 开发的自改进 AI 代理，具备内置学习循环，可通过 CLI 或消息网关使用，并支持从 OpenClaw 迁移。

repositories.name: skills
repositories.summary: 该项目是Codex的技能目录，收录了可供AI代理发现和使用的指令、脚本与资源，以帮助其完成特定任务。

repositories.name: opencode
repositories.summary: opencode 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，支持命令行和桌面应用，可辅助开发与代码探索。

repositories.name: humanizer
repositories.description: Agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text
repositories.summary: Humanizer 是一个智能体技能，用于改写 AI 生成的文本，使其读起来像人写的，同时保持原意不变。

repositories.name: llvm-project
repositories.description: The LLVM Project is a collection of modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies.
repositories.summary: LLVM项目是一套模块化、可复用的编译器及工具链技术集合，用于构建高度优化的编译器、优化器和运行时环境。

repositories.name: ponytail
repositories.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
repositories.summary: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 插件，通过规则和钩子让 AI 编程代理遵循极简编码风格，优先选择最简单方案并避免不必要代码。

repositories.name: ruflo
repositories.description: 🌊 The original agent meta-harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
repositories.summary: Ruflo 是一个为 Claude Code 和 Codex 设计的智能体元框架，提供百余种智能体、自适应记忆、RAG 集成及多智能体协作能力，用于构建和协调自主工作流。

repositories.name: magnitude
repositories.description: Open source inference server that runs the best local models for your hardware, plugged into the agent you already use. Works with Pi, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, Codex, Claude Code, Oh My Pi, and Cline.
repositories.summary: Magnitude 是一个开源推理服务器，能分析硬件并推荐、下载、调优和运行本地模型，供 Pi、OpenCode 等智能体使用。

repositories.name: FckSignups
repositories.description: A list of tools that are open-source, in-browser, and require no-signups!
repositories.summary: 一个收录无需注册即可在浏览器中使用的开源工具的精选列表网站，基于React和TypeScript构建。

repositories.name: marketingskills
repositories.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
repositories.summary: 为AI代理提供营销技能库，涵盖转化优化、文案、SEO、分析和增长工程等任务。

repositories.name: open-science
repositories.description: Open Science by AIPOCH is an open-source, local-first, model-agnostic AI research workbench for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with scientific agents, Python/R notebooks, data connectors, and reproducible provenance.
repositories.summary: Open Science 是一个开源、本地优先、模型无关的 AI 科研工作台，支持科学代理、Python/R 笔记本、数据连接器和可复现溯源。

repositories.name: openwhispr
repositories.description: Voice-to-text dictation app with local (Nvidia Parakeet/Whisper) and cloud models (BYOK). Privacy-first and available cross-platform.
repositories.summary: OpenWhispr 是一款跨平台的开源语音转文字听写应用，支持本地或云端模型，注重隐私保护，并提供会议转录、笔记和 AI 助手等功能。

repositories.name: skills
repositories.summary: HumanLayer 提供的 Claude Code 技能集合，包含改进 CLAUDE.md、收窄 React 属性类型、构建代理循环等开发辅助工具。

repositories.name: AutoHedge
repositories.description: Build your autonomous hedge fund in minutes. AutoHedge harnesses the power of swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution.
repositories.summary: AutoHedge是一个基于多智能体与群体智能的自动化对冲基金系统，可在Solana上自主完成市场分析、风险管理和交易执行。

repositories.name: stremio-web
repositories.summary: Stremio Web 是 Stremio 的官方网页界面，基于 React 和 WebAssembly 引擎，支持插件扩展、跨设备同步及 Chromecast 投屏，用于在线观看影视和频道。
